verdict.rationale: The official CLI README documents both install scopes. Project scope is the default and writes to `./<agent>/skills/`, "Committed with your project, shared with team." Global scope uses `-g`, writes to `~/<agent>/skills/`, and is "Available across all projects," with a concrete `-g` usage example. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scoped installs land in the documented paths.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose install scope — project-local files committed with my repo, or user-global across all projects

citations.quote: **Project** | (default) | `./<agent>/skills/` | Committed with your project, shared with team
